error_policy.api_failed: counts as wrong in verdict accuracy, stays in denominator
error_policy.invalid_contract: counts as wrong in verdict accuracy, stays in denominator
error_policy.missing: counts as wrong in verdict accuracy, stays in denominator
error_policy.note: indeterminate is an explicit system abstention and never equals correct

limitations: Frozen and simulated sources keep api_failed/invalid_contract/missing cases in every denominator.
CAS-on-GT uses reference steps; it bounds the pipeline but is not available at inference time.
Prompt/CAS tuning saw all 100 GT examples, so results on dev/final splits are exploratory, not independent holdout.
CDN/OS availability noise and OCR failures are reported as statuses and are not silently dropped.
